resources.string: Your previous data is retained separately and has not been restored. Device sync and account features remain paused. You can count new matches offline.

This app was restored or updated. Your previous data is kept safely but is not shown yet.

Restore: the data is copied for this device with a new device identity. Data linked to an account only appears after you sign in with that same account; data without an account appears on this device. Sign in again afterwards and confirm pairing on your watch.

Start without it: the previous data stays stored on this device but is not used.

Matches were already counted on this device since the update or restore. Restoring would hide them. Delete those matches first to restore, or start without the previous data. Your previous data stays stored either way.
Restoring did not work. Nothing was changed and your previous data is still kept. Try again later or start without it.

This device now has its own new identity. Data linked to an account appears after you sign in with that same account – a different account sees none of it. If you use a watch, confirm pairing again on the watch.
Local data could not be checked. Counting, device sync and account features are paused. Try again to repeat this check. Existing match data is kept.
